name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.APre.stable
typeText:
∀ (k : Nat) (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) {V : List.{0} Nat},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.SafeVars V →
    DisequalityDispersion.Machine.I_ 0 ∉ V →
      DisequalityDispersion.Machine.OUT_ 0 ∉ V →
        DisequalityDispersion.Machine.X_ 1 ∉ V →
          DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 1 ∉ V →
            DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 2 ∉ V →
              DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 3 ∉ V →
                DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 4 ∉ V →
                  ∀ {m m₁ : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem},
                    DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Agree m m₁ V →
                      DisequalityDispersion.Machine.APre k g m →
                        And (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.APre k g m₁)
                          (And
                            (Eq.{1} (m₁ (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 1)) (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 1)))
                            (And
                              (Eq.{1} (m₁ (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 2))
                                (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 2)))
                              (And
                                (Eq.{1} (m₁ (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.OUT_ 0))
                                  (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.OUT_ 0)))
                                (And
                                  (∀ (x : Nat),
                                    LE.le.{0} DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN x →
                                      LT.lt.{0} x (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP) → Eq.{1} (m₁ x) (m x))
                                  (Eq.{1}
                                    (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.arrAt m₁ (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.OUT_ 0)))
                                    (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.arrAt m
                                      (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.OUT_ 0))))))))

source.code:
theorem APre.stable (k : ℕ) (g : GInstance) {V : List ℕ} (hV : SafeVars V) (hI : I_ 0 ∉ V)
    (hO : OUT_ 0 ∉ V) (hX : X_ 1 ∉ V) (h1 : G_ 1 ∉ V) (h2 : G_ 2 ∉ V) (h3 : G_ 3 ∉ V) (h4 : G_ 4 ∉ V)
    {m m₁ : Mem} (hag : Agree m m₁ V) (h : APre k g m) :
    APre k g m₁ ∧ m₁ (G_ 1) = m (G_ 1) ∧ m₁ (G_ 2) = m (G_ 2) ∧ m₁ (OUT_ 0) = m (OUT_ 0) ∧
      (∀ x, IN ≤ x → x < m HP → m₁ x = m x) ∧ arrAt m₁ (m (OUT_ 0)) = arrAt m (m (OUT_ 0)) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨h4', h34⟩, hz⟩ := h
  have hhp : 200 ≤ m HP := h4'.1.1.1.ctx.2.2
  obtain ⟨hs', hG1, hG2, hG3, hG4, hO', hheap, harr⟩ := SPre4.stable k g hV hI hO hX h1 h2 h3 h4 hag h4'
  refine ⟨⟨⟨hs', by rw [hG3, hG4]; exact h34⟩, ?_⟩, hG1, hG2, hO', hheap, harr⟩
  rw [hG3, hag.var ZERO (lt_hp hhp (by decide)) (by decide) (fun h => by have := (hV ZERO h).1; addr3)]
  exact hz
